[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Veln Fessor''' was a ranking [[Office of Peace and Security]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="Halves" /> Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], <ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. The ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Blinking Eyes: Halves]]'' is therefore dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref>  Fessor investigated the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Narl Gorjax]], an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to Gadrin's political leader [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Barnab Chistor]], who had been [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] in the Gadrin glitz club [[Star Shocked]].<ref name="Halves" />
